resources.description: Fresh probe of your endpoint plus an Ed25519-signed quality attestation (compact JWS, 24h TTL) you can embed in your 402 responses to raise buyer conversion.

Router-grade bulk quality feed: every tracked endpoint with score, grade, availability, latency percentiles, price, uptime streak and freshness in one pull. Designed for routers/aggregators to ingest.
Ranked directory of x402 endpoints by measured live quality (not by on-chain volume). Includes score, grade, latency and pricing per endpoint.
Live quality verdict for any x402 endpoint: availability, latency percentiles, 402-offer conformance, price-drift and payTo-stability flags. Deterministic and re-verifiable.
